description: This file contains the implementation of Support Vector Machine (SVM) models and training algorithms in Apache Spark's MLlib, including the SVMModel class, SVMWithSGD trainer, and related object methods for training and loading models.

classes.name: SVMModel
classes.description: Represents a Support Vector Machine model with methods for prediction, threshold management, and model persistence.

classes.name: SVMWithSGD
classes.description: Trainer class for SVM using Stochastic Gradient Descent with configurable parameters.

methods.name: setThreshold
methods.description: Sets the threshold for converting raw prediction scores into binary predictions.

methods.name: getThreshold
methods.description: Returns the current threshold used for prediction.

methods.name: clearThreshold
methods.description: Clears the threshold, so predictions output raw scores.

methods.name: predictPoint
methods.description: Computes the raw prediction score or class label based on the margin.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the model to the specified path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a model from the specified path.

methods.name: createModel
methods.description: Creates a new SVMModel instance with given weights and intercept.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Trains an SVM model with specified parameters and initial weights.
